no_spec_change_rationale: FLOW-18 already requires the docs and skill to say what current main does. REQ-cli-016 already updates a file byte-identical to a known earlier bundle and leaves an edited copy. This change registers main 0fd9fd22's stages.md digest and qualifies one architecture sentence. No requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: A pristine copy of the workflow stages file from main 0fd9fd22 is known-outdated and chough skill update replaces it with the current bundle. An edited copy of that file stays byte-identical. docs/architecture.md says an exact open session ID is returned without reading another session, a bare key or alias reads each open session, and a name that matches none also reads archived stories.
